title: Understanding dream symbols without a one-size-fits-all dictionary
intro: Symbols become useful when they connect to your memory, feelings, and current life.

sections.heading: Notice the feeling
sections.body: The emotional temperature of a dream often carries more information than the object itself.

sections.heading: Ask what changed
sections.body: Look for the moment the dream shifted, opened, closed, or became urgent.

sections.heading: Let meaning unfold
sections.body: A dream can hold more than one honest reading. Give it time.
